[Testing] Repository test guidance prefers `Arguments.argumentSet(...)` for named method-source cases (`.github/agents/knowledge/testing-general-patterns.md:69-71`). Using `{0}` makes the description an unused test parameter and requires a suppression; make the parameterized test unnamed, remove `description`, and name each row with `Arguments.argumentSet(...)`.
